title: AI Customer Support Assistant on WhatsApp and Web
seoTitle: AI Customer Support Assistant for Indian Businesses
seoDescription: An AI support assistant that answers customer questions on WhatsApp and your website from your own documents and order data, and hands off to staff.
summary: An AI customer support assistant answers routine questions on WhatsApp and your website using your own product documents, policies and order data, and hands complex or sensitive conversations to a person with the context attached. It gives customers instant answers at any hour while your team focuses on the conversations that need judgement.

dataPoints.label: Knowledge sources
dataPoints.value: Product manuals, FAQs, policies, order and delivery status

dataPoints.label: Handoff
dataPoints.value: To a human with the conversation history when confidence is low or the customer asks

dataPoints.label: Payback driver
dataPoints.value: Faster responses, fewer repeat calls, support hours saved

body:
## What makes it reliable

- Answers come from your approved content using [retrieval](/glossary/rag), not the model's general knowledge.
- It says when it does not know and hands off.
- Order status comes from live system data, not guesses.
- Every answer is logged for review.

## Start narrow

Pick the ten questions customers ask most, measure accuracy on real past chats, then expand. See the [AI chatbot cost guide](/cost/ai-chatbot) and [how to build an AI chatbot trained on your company documents](/blog/how-to-build-an-ai-chatbot-trained-on-your-company-documents).

faqs.a: Grounding in your documents and strict handoff rules keep this rare; testing measures it before launch.

faqs.q: Can it take actions like rescheduling?
faqs.a: Yes, with carefully limited actions and confirmation steps.

accuracy: Typically resolves 40–70% of routine questions when grounded in good documentation
